parameters.note: Shadow Lake is a high alpine lake in the Desolation Wilderness (El Dorado Co.), in the Meeks Creek drainage: it lies within the Lake Tahoe basin (Meeks Creek flows down to Meeks Bay on Lake Tahoe's west shore) but is a lake high up a chain — Lake Genevieve, Crag Lake, Hidden Lake, Shadow Lake, Stony Ridge Lake, Rubicon Lake — well above the 'first lake' (Lake Genevieve). The special Lake Tahoe tributary closure (§7.50(b)(152), which reaches only flowing Tahoe tributaries upstream to the first lake, and the lake within 300 ft of tributary mouths) therefore does not apply to Shadow Lake itself. The lake is not listed by name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1): open all year, 5/10. Shadow Lake is not in CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document, and no current authoritative source names a fish population here, so species and stocking are intentionally left empty; the season/bag/license rows below state what governs the lake body under general regulation, independent of whether fish are present.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
